about_the_game:
Customize your Beys more freely than ever! The Pattern & Color Expansion Kit is here!

Plus, a shopkeeper selling Hologram Coating Agent, Skeleton Coating Agent, and Color Agent (Orange / White) will appear at the shop in the BBR venue!

Contents:

Bey Coating Patterns ×2 (Hologram Coat / Skeleton Coat)

Colors ×2 (Orange / White)

Hologram Coating Agent ×3

Skeleton Coating Agent ×3

Color Agent (Orange) ×3

Color Agent (White) ×3

A shopkeeper selling Hologram Coating Agent, Skeleton Coating Agent, and Color Agent (Orange / White) will appear at the shop in the BBR venue.
